row_semantics: Each row represents a specific condition or action related to the ambient lamp's brightness control logic.

column_semantics.Column 1: Condition Type (e.g., Precondition, Trigger Condition, Action, Exit Condition, Exception Handling)
column_semantics.Column 2: Description of the Condition or Action

core_entities.name: Ambient Lamp
core_entities.description: The lighting system that provides ambient illumination inside the vehicle.

core_entities.name: FtwlFLLampBrtnsCmd_l
core_entities.description: Signal requesting changes to the ambient lamp's brightness level.

core_entities.name: FtwlFLLampOnOff_l
core_entities.description: Signal to turn the ambient lamp on or off.

core_entities.name: FtwlFLLampFadeSpdCmd_l
core_entities.description: Signal specifying the fade speed for turning the ambient lamp on or off.

core_entities.name: ZCU
core_entities.description: Zone Control Unit, responsible for sending LIN signals to control the ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: PWM
core_entities.description: Pulse Width Modulation signal used to drive and adjust the brightness of the ambient lamp.

core_conditions.name: Precondition
core_conditions.description: Ambient lamp is in the closed state.

core_conditions.name: Trigger Condition
core_conditions.description: Receiving a local control module request signal FtwlFLLampBrtnsCmd_l changing from 0x00 (No Request) to any other value.

core_conditions.name: Exit Conditions
description: Receiving FtwlFLLampBrtnsCmd_l = 0x00 (No Request), maintaining current brightness.
Receiving FtwlFLLampOnOff_l = 0x00 (OFF), turning off the ambient lamp with a specified fade speed.
Receiving FtwlFLLampBrtnsCmd_l in the range 0x65-0xFF, maintaining current brightness (reserved for future use).

core_outputs.name: PWM Signal
core_outputs.description: Generated by the ambient lamp driver control module to set the corresponding brightness level.

core_faults.name: Overvoltage/Undervoltage Fault
core_faults.description: If the ambient lamp module experiences overvoltage or undervoltage, the ambient lamp is directly turned off.

core_faults.name: LIN Signal Timeout
core_faults.description: If no LIN signal from ZCU is received within a certain time (default 6 seconds), the ambient lamp is directly turned off.

core_faults.name: Brightness Value Abnormality
core_faults.description: If the ambient lamp brightness value FtwlFLLampBrtnsCmd_l is abnormal, it maintains the previous moment's state value.

core_timing_constraints.name: LIN Signal Timeout
core_timing_constraints.description: Default timeout period for receiving LIN signals from ZCU.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the logic for controlling the brightness of the ambient lamp based on input signals from the local control module and ZCU. It specifies how the PWM signal is generated to adjust brightness, under what conditions the lamp should turn off, and how faults are handled.
uncertain_points: The exact meaning of 'local control module' is not explicitly defined in the table.
The specific values for '0x65-0xFF' are reserved for future use and their behavior is not detailed.
